description: This is a Go test source file for the UserArtifactsManager component within the 'orchestrator' package, containing unit tests for directory creation, listing, and artifact update functionalities.

methods.name: TestNewDir
methods.description: Tests the creation of a new user artifacts directory and verifies its existence.

methods.name: TestListDirsAndNoDirHasBeenCreated
methods.description: Tests listing directories when none have been created, expecting an empty list.

methods.name: TestListTokens
methods.description: Tests listing of directories after creating multiple directories.

methods.name: TestCreateArtifactDirectoryDoesNotExist
methods.description: Verifies error handling when trying to update an artifact in a non-existent directory.

methods.name: TestCreateArtifactsSucceeds
methods.description: Tests successful creation and storage of multiple artifact chunks, verifying the final combined content.
